ideas.title: Birdie Bus launch: The mobile golf simulator arrives
ideas.hook: We turned a step van into a golf simulator. Here's how.
ideas.concept: Origin story video showing the transformation from empty van to fully branded Birdie Bus with Trackman 4, drop-down stage, and crowd-facing setup. Build anticipation for the launch.

shots.angle: WIDE SHOT: Stand back 10 feet from the bus. Hold phone horizontally (landscape). Prop phone on a stable surface or use a tripod at chest height. Frame the entire side of the bus.
shots.action: Slow pan from left to right across the empty van interior. Keep phone steady. Move slowly, about 5 seconds for the full pan.
shots.say: This was just an empty step van 6 months ago.
shots.videography_tip: Use landscape mode. If you don't have a tripod, stack books or use a water bottle to prop the phone. Natural light from the open door works best. Record for 10 seconds, you'll trim to 5.

shots.angle: TIME-LAPSE OR QUICK CUTS: Mount phone on a tripod or stable surface inside the bus. Portrait mode (vertical) for TikTok/Reels.
shots.action: Film 3-5 short clips (2-3 seconds each) of the build: tools, branding being applied, screen being mounted. Or use time-lapse mode if your phone has it.
shots.say: We spent months turning it into something nobody in Southwest Florida has seen.
shots.videography_tip: For quick cuts: record 5 separate 3-second clips. For time-lapse: prop phone, hit record, do 30 minutes of work, stop. iPhone: Camera app > Time-Lapse. Android: Open Camera app > Time lapse.

shots.angle: CLOSE-UP: Phone in portrait mode, held at eye level, 3 feet from the Trackman screen. Focus on the screen.
shots.action: Press the power button on the Trackman. Screen lights up showing a golf course. Hold steady for 4 seconds.
shots.say: Now it's a full golf simulator on wheels.
shots.videography_tip: Clean the screen first. Turn off overhead lights to reduce glare. If screen looks washed out, tap the screen on your phone to focus and slide the exposure down slightly.

shots.angle: EXTERIOR WIDE: Stand 15 feet back from the bus. Phone horizontal. Frame the bus and the area in front where people gather.
shots.action: Have someone press the button to drop the stage. Film it lowering. Then film 2-3 people walking up and looking at the bus.
shots.say: And we bring it to you. Weddings, corporate events, tournaments.
shots.videography_tip: Golden hour (1 hour before sunset) makes this shot look 10x better. If you can't do golden hour, overcast days are best for even lighting. Avoid harsh midday sun.

shots.angle: CLOSE-UP: Phone portrait, held by a friend or on a small tripod, 4 feet from the golfer. Focus on hands and club.
shots.action: Golfer takes a smooth, slow swing. Ball hits screen. Capture the moment of impact and the ball flight on screen in the background.
shots.say: Trackman 4. Real data. Real fun. Book us.
shots.videography_tip: Use slow-motion mode if your phone has it (iPhone: Slo-mo, 240fps). Record 10 seconds, trim to the 4 seconds with the best swing. Make sure the Trackman screen is visible in the background.

ideas.caption: From empty van to mobile golf experience. Birdie Bus is here. 🚌⛳ #golf #mobilegolf #trackman #swfl #birdiebus
ideas.notes: Launch announcement video. Film the actual bus reveal if possible. Total runtime: ~24 seconds. Edit in CapCut (free) or iMovie: trim clips, add text overlay for hook, add trending audio at low volume (20%) under voiceover.

ideas.title: Grant Thornton Invitational sponsor activation
ideas.hook: We're activating at the Grant Thornton Invitational. Here's what that means for your brand.
ideas.concept: B2B-focused content targeting potential sponsors. Show the Birdie Bus setup at Tiburón, the crowd engagement, and the branding opportunities.

shots.angle: AERIAL/WIDE: If you have a drone, fly it 50 feet up. If not, stand on any elevated surface (hill, balcony, stairs). Phone horizontal.
shots.action: Slow pan across Tiburón Golf Club. Show the course, the crowds, the tents.
shots.say: This December, the best golfers in the world are at Tiburón.
shots.videography_tip: No drone? No problem. Shoot from the highest point you can find. Even 10 feet of elevation helps. Keep the horizon level.

shots.angle: MEDIUM SHOT: Phone horizontal, chest height, 8 feet from the bus. Frame the bus with the sponsor branding visible.
shots.action: Slow zoom in (use your feet, walk closer) on the branded bus. Show people interacting with it.
shots.say: And Birdie Bus is right in the middle of it with a branded activation.
shots.videography_tip: Walk slowly and steadily. Bend your knees slightly to reduce bounce. If you have a gimbal (DJI Osmo, etc.), use it. If not, just walk slow.

shots.angle: CLOSE-UP: Phone portrait, 3 feet from the leaderboard screen. Focus on the screen showing names and scores.
shots.action: Capture a guest swinging, then cut to the leaderboard updating with their score.
shots.say: Your logo on the leaderboard. Your brand in front of an affluent, engaged crowd.
shots.videography_tip: Film the swing in one clip, the leaderboard in another. You'll cut them together in editing. Make sure the sponsor logo is visible on screen.

shots.angle: TALKING HEAD: Phone on tripod or propped at eye level, 3 feet away. Portrait mode. Plain background (bus interior or solid wall).
shots.action: Look directly at the camera. Speak clearly and confidently. Smile.
shots.say: We have 3 sponsorship tiers left. DM me or check the link in bio.
shots.videography_tip: Look at the lens, not the screen. Put a small piece of tape on the floor where you stand so you hit the same spot every take. Do 3 takes, pick the best. Natural light from a window in front of you is best.

ideas.caption: December 7-13. Grant Thornton Invitational. Your brand on the Birdie Bus. Limited spots. #golfsponsor #sportmarketing #naplesflorida #grantthorntoninvitational
ideas.notes: Target sponsors: Naples Jet Center, STOCK, Herc, Publix, Elite Jets. Post during tournament week if possible. Total runtime: ~18 seconds.

ideas.title: Wedding venue activation: The coolest reception add-on
ideas.hook: Your wedding guests will never forget this.
ideas.concept: Target wedding planners and engaged couples. Show Birdie Bus at a wedding reception with guests playing closest-to-the-pin, bride/groom swinging, crowd cheering.

shots.angle: MEDIUM SHOT: Phone portrait, held by a friend or on tripod, 6 feet away. Frame the bride and groom from waist up.
shots.action: Bride and groom walk toward the bus, looking curious and excited.
shots.say: You spent months planning the perfect wedding.
shots.videography_tip: Have the couple walk toward the camera. Film 3 takes. The natural, candid reaction is better than a posed one.

shots.angle: MEDIUM WIDE: Phone horizontal, 10 feet back. Frame a group of guests around the bus.
shots.action: Film guests laughing, high-fiving, taking turns. Get 3-4 different groups if possible.
shots.say: But your guests will remember this.
shots.videography_tip: Candid shots work best. Don't ask people to look at the camera. Film them actually having fun. Get a mix of close-ups and wide shots.

shots.angle: CLOSE-UP: Phone portrait, 4 feet away. Focus on the bride's face and upper body.
shots.action: Bride takes a swing in her dress. Capture her reaction (smile, laugh, cheer).
shots.say: Even the bride plays.
shots.videography_tip: This is the money shot. Do multiple takes. Get her laughing, get her concentrating, get her celebrating. Slow-motion if possible.

shots.angle: DETAIL SHOT: Phone portrait, 2 feet away. Focus on hands.
shots.action: Close-up of the bride's hand with wedding ring, holding a golf club. Slow, steady shot.
shots.say: Birdie Bus. The wedding add-on nobody forgets. Book for your date.
shots.videography_tip: This is a detail shot for the edit. Hold steady for 5 seconds. The ring + club combo tells the whole story in one image.

ideas.caption: The wedding add-on your guests will actually talk about. 🚌💍⛳ #wedding #weddingreception #birdiebus #golfwedding #swflwedding
ideas.notes: Wedding venues are priority #1. Target: Heitman House, Burroughs Home, other SWFL venues. Total runtime: ~16 seconds. Film at an actual wedding if possible, or stage with friends.

ideas.title: Corporate event: Team building that doesn't suck
ideas.hook: Your team building event doesn't have to be awkward.
ideas.concept: Target corporate event planners. Show a company happy hour with Birdie Bus, coworkers competing on closest-to-the-pin, boss playing, team bonding.

shots.angle: MEDIUM SHOT: Phone horizontal, 8 feet away. Frame a group of office workers looking bored at a typical corporate event.
shots.action: Film people standing around awkwardly, checking phones, forced smiles. Keep it brief.
shots.say: Another trust fall? Another awkward icebreaker?
shots.videography_tip: This is the "before" shot. You can stage this with friends or use stock footage. The contrast is what matters.

shots.angle: MEDIUM WIDE: Phone horizontal, 10 feet back. Frame the Birdie Bus with a group of coworkers around it.
shots.action: Film coworkers laughing, competing, high-fiving. Show genuine fun.
shots.say: Or you could do this.
shots.videography_tip: Cut quickly from the boring shot to this one. The energy shift is the hook. Film real reactions.

shots.angle: CLOSE-UP: Phone portrait, 3 feet from the leaderboard screen.
shots.action: Show the leaderboard updating with names and scores. Focus on the competition.
shots.say: Real competition. Real data. Real fun.
shots.videography_tip: Make sure the names and scores are readable. Film in good lighting. If the screen is hard to read, shoot at a slight angle to reduce glare.

shots.angle: GROUP SHOT: Phone horizontal, 12 feet back. Frame the whole group with the bus in the background.
shots.action: Group poses for a photo or cheers together. Genuine smiles.
shots.say: Birdie Bus. Corporate events your team will actually want to attend. Book now.
shots.videography_tip: Get the group to do a cheer or toast. Film 2-3 takes. This is the feel-good ending shot.

ideas.caption: Team building that doesn't feel like a trust fall. 🚌⛳ #corporateevents #teambuilding #birdiebus #golf #swflbusiness
ideas.notes: Target: corporate event planners, HR directors, office managers in SWFL. Total runtime: ~16 seconds.

ideas.title: Behind the scenes: Trackman 4 setup
ideas.hook: This is $25,000 of golf technology in a van.
ideas.concept: Tech-focused content for golf enthusiasts. Show the Trackman 4 setup, the screen, the accuracy, the data. Appeal to serious golfers.

shots.angle: CLOSE-UP: Phone portrait, 2 feet from the Trackman 4 unit. Slow pan across the device.
shots.action: Slow, smooth pan from left to right across the Trackman unit. Show the details.
shots.say: This is the same technology the pros use.
shots.videography_tip: Move slowly and steadily. Use a small tripod or prop the phone on a stable surface. Natural light is best. If indoors, use a ring light or desk lamp to reduce shadows.

shots.angle: CLOSE-UP: Phone portrait, 2 feet from the screen. Focus on the data display.
shots.action: Show the screen with ball flight data: speed, spin rate, carry distance, launch angle. Tap each metric as you mention it.
shots.say: Ball speed. Spin rate. Carry distance. Launch angle.
shots.videography_tip: Clean the screen first. Turn off overhead lights to reduce glare. Tap the screen on your phone to focus, then slide exposure down if the screen is too bright.

shots.angle: SPLIT SCREEN: Film two separate clips. Clip 1: Golfer swinging (medium shot, 6 feet away). Clip 2: Screen showing the resulting ball flight.
shots.action: Film the swing in one clip. Film the screen result in another. You'll edit them side-by-side or back-to-back.
shots.say: And it's accurate to within a yard.
shots.videography_tip: For split screen: use CapCut or iMovie. Place the swing on the left, the screen on the right. Or do a quick cut between them. The key is showing cause and effect.

shots.angle: WIDE SHOT: Phone horizontal, 15 feet back. Frame the full Birdie Bus setup at an event.
shots.action: Slow pan across the entire setup: bus, screen, guests playing, crowd watching.
shots.say: All in a van. All at your event. Book Birdie Bus.
shots.videography_tip: Golden hour lighting makes this shot pop. If you can't do golden hour, overcast days are best. Avoid harsh shadows on people's faces.

ideas.caption: The same technology the pros use. In a van. At your event. 🚌⛳ #trackman #golf #golftechnology #birdiebus #golfsimulator
ideas.notes: Appeal to serious golfers and golf clubs. Emphasize Trackman 4 accuracy. Total runtime: ~17 seconds.
